summary: Backend + frontend verified for new /api/payments/paged and /api/tenants/paged endpoints (25-per-page, server-side search/filter/summary) and 30s cache with immediate invalidation on mutations. Backend 11/11 pytest green. Frontend desktop (Betalingen + Huurders) and mobile (Betalingen) acceptance flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py:7190 /tenants/paged computes natural-sort over the full filtered list on every call; fine today (bounded to 1000 tenants in _tenants_enriched) but tenant limit=1000 and payments find limit=5000 are hard caps that should be revisited when a company exceeds those thresholds.

/app/backend/server.py:8866 /payments/paged limits month fetch to 5000 docs — single busy month at scale could silently cap; add log/warning or switch to real DB-side pagination when count approaches cap.
_list_cached shares the same process-local _INVOICE_CACHE as invoices; single-worker safe but will diverge across workers if scaled horizontally.
seed_data_creation: Used existing Testhuurder 00..39 perf-test seed from iter 76. Also created+deleted one TEST_iter77_cacheinv tenant for cache-invalidation test — self-cleaned.
